cover_headline: Ramayana Nears ₹1,700 Crore Worldwide, Passes Dhurandhar 2 in the US
facts: Ramayana stands at ₹1,693.50 crore worldwide gross in 18 days — ₹1,126.50 crore gross in India and ₹567 crore overseas, per Sacnilk
Its $28.4 million US total has passed Dhurandhar: The Revenge's $28.1 million to become the highest-grossing Indian film ever in the US
Day 18 brought ₹35.60 crore net in India, up 28.8 per cent from Day 17, across 16,277 shows at 37.9 per cent occupancy

end.headline: Ramayana Nears ₹1,700 Crore Worldwide, Passes Dhurandhar 2 in the US
end.line: Day 18 added ₹35.60 crore net in India as the worldwide gross hit ₹1,693.50 crore — and its $28.4 million US total is now the highest ever for an Indian film.
